name: MaaT Pharma S.A.
summary: MaaT Pharma SA operates as a clinical-stage biotechnology company, focused on the discovery and advancement of microbiome-based biotherapies, primarily for the treatment of solid cancer tumors. Its development pipeline features MaaT013, which has successfully completed Phase 2 clinical trials for acute graft-versus-host disease (aGVHD) and is also undergoing preclinical evaluation for melanoma. Another therapeutic candidate, MaaT033, is currently in Phase 1b clinical trials, aiming to improve survival outcomes for patients with acute myeloid leukemia (AML) or other liquid malignancies following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Furthermore, MaaT03X is being developed specifically for solid tumor applications. The company was founded in 2014 and maintains its headquarters in Lyon, France.
